notes.title: DEATHSTORM PART 3: OBLITERATION - PATCH 1.5.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12455972/73d2dc22b76718c4661b1c5c5fbc09c1a31cb72e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Patch 1.5.0[/h1]


[b]DEATHSTORM PART 3: OBLITERATION[/b] is the final chapter in a new three-part campaign for SNIPER ELITE® 4, taking fans back to World War 2 Germany for the first time since SNIPER ELITE® V2 in 2012.
 
It's in the Bavarian town of Steigerloch, in the heartland of Germany, where the abominable nuclear project known as Deathstorm is being researched. A heavily guarded underground complex is rumoured to lie hidden beneath the sleepy town's hilltop church, with suspicious vehicle activity suggesting the Nazis are planning something big - and soon. Elite agent Karl Fairburne must draw on all his skills to neutralize the facility and bring Deathstorm down, once and for all.

[h1]By Popular Demand[/h1][list]
[*]Players can now select custom reticles for their rifle scopes.
[*]Add “[b]Clear All Collectibles” and “Clear Level Collectibles[/b]” to the Service Record for players wishing to reset and replay missions.
[*]Add ability to select wind strength from within the Shooting Range level.
[*]Add an option to remember the zoom level when entering scope/binoculars.[/list]
[h1]New Content[/h1][list]
[*]New multiplayer map (Bunker), [b]FREE[/b] to all owners of the game and playable in all multiplayer modes (excluding No-Cross).
[*]New survival map (Facility), [b]FREE[/b] to all owners of the game and playable in both solo-survival and up to 4-player co-op.
[*]New “[b]Authentic Plus[/b]” difficulty options for an increased level of challenge. Some difficulty options have been changed to support this as the equivalent of “Authentic” difficulty can now be created from Custom options (e.g., Authentic Suppressors has become Authentic Attachments to control scope zoom as well as suppressor noise).
[*]Custom Difficulty now has some extended options.[list] 
[*]AI Aggression will make the AI never give up searching once alerted if set to Authentic Plus.
[*]Authentic Suppressors has now become Authentic Attachment. It will make [*]Suppressed shots still make some noise, and also limit the zoom level of Scopes and Binoculars. Any old saves with this enabled will now also limit the zoom level.
[*]Player Toughness will now disable Character Skills and Weapon Upgrades if set to Authentic or Authentic Plus. Any old saves will retain whether they had Character Skills and Weapon Upgrades enabled/disabled.[/list]
[*]Save Option allows the save types available to be set.
[*]Increased [b]maximum player rank to 250[/b].
[*]Six new Axis character skins from Deathstorm that can be unlocked for use in Multiplayer.
[*]Support for Deathstorm Part 3: Obliteration and [b]Lock And Load Weapon Pack[/b].[/list]
[h1]Singleplayer[/h1][list]
[*]Various fixes to the use of character skins other than Karl.
[*]Vehicles stop firing once the gunner has been killed, rather than completing the current burst.
[*]Tagging hats and binoculars dropped by AI no longer tags the AI that dropped them.
[*]Various fixes to make the neunfaust less awkward to use.
[*]Fix various machine guns stuttering when firing from hip.
[*]Artillery spotters no longer slide around while firing their flare.
[*]Vehicles in convoy should wait until the vehicle in front is fully destroyed before resuming their route to avoid getting caught in the final explosion, and vehicles should never start moving if their driver is dead.
[*]Multiple bug fixes to campaign and multiplayer levels[/list]
[h1]Multiplayer[/h1][list]
[*]Various capture-the-flag fixes to prevent flag pickup from appearing inside geometry or sliding around the level.
[*]Fire should now cause damage to players in headshots-only mode.
[*]Vehicle collisions should now kill incapacitated players in co-op.
[*]AI continue to target incapacitated players in Survival until they are fully incapacitated.
[*]Fix so firing any suppressed shot won’t ping location on enemy radar
[*]Fixed melee kill prompt that occasionally stopped being allowed for some players.[/list]
[h1]Dedicated Server[/h1][list]
[*]Add Server.KickBanSteamID command (and output the numeric Steam ID in appropriate places for server admins), to allow banning by Steam ID without that player necessarily needing to be connected at the time of the ban.
[*]Show the IP of the client connections in the player list for remote RCON.
[*]Fixed and improved the reporting of player information in the remote RCON web interface. Now reporting kills, score and deaths.
[*]Added a script tab for automating remote RCON tasks
[*]Updated dedicated server command reference documentation
[/list]

notes.title: Sniper Elite 4 Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
See Steam guide [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=935973541]here[/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PrBBK1p.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.4[/h1]
[b]By popular demand:[/b][list]
[*]Allow players to use any unlocked or purchased allied DLC character skins in any game mode including Campaign, if they have previously completed the Campaign level.[/list]

[b]New Content:[/b][list]
[*]New multiplayer map (Fortress), [b]FREE[/b] to all owners of the game and playable in all multiplayer modes including No-Cross.
[*]New survival map (Winter Market), [b]FREE[/b] to all owners of the game and playable in both solo-survival and up to 4-player co-op.
[*]Support for Cold Warfare Winter Expansion Pack.[/list]

[b]Multiplayer:[/b][list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/M7j4dlN.jpg[/img]

[*]Client no longer spawns out-of-world when host selects to restart a mission.
[*]Players no longer get stuck with a vote-in-progress when migrating to a new host.
[*]Fix tagging through walls.
[*]Aim-assist correctly rendered if difficulty changed during a co-op match.[/list]

[b]Singleplayer:[/b][list]
[*]Danger Cameras no longer play in slo-mo when player has radial menu open.
[*]Altered neunfaust firing to reduce chances of player blowing themselves up.
[*]AI are now slightly more likely to avoid vehicles and should not get stuck on ladders due to checkpoint loads.
[*]Booby-trapped bodies now explode more reliably.
[*]Ammo pickups now collected faster.
[*]Fix rumbles occasionally getting stuck on when switching between gamepad and mouse.
[*]Fixed PS4 controller prompts where stick icons were being used instead of triggers.
[*]Audio no longer cuts out during Island cutscene introduction when the tutorial is disabled.
[*]Lots of audio fixes to improve performance, reduce stuttering and improve behaviour of Steam voice chat.
[*]Fix FMV subtitle size in eyefinity.[/list]

notes.title: NOW LIVE - PATCH 1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]FREE MP MODE AND MAP[/h1]

In our first wave of free new content, we're introducing the [b]Elimination[/b] game mode. A 2-team mode for up to 12 players, this is last-team-standing with a twist - you can bring back fallen comrades by taking down your enemies. One kill can make all the difference.

We're also releasing our first free MP map, [b]Night Woods[/b].

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hG3OpQj.jpg[/img]

[h1]PATCH 1.2[/h1]

[b]New Content [/b]
[list]
[*]Free Elimination multiplayer mode, available on all existing multiplayer maps.
[*]Free Night Woods multiplayer map, supports all competitive modes including Elimination.
[*]Support for Deathstorm Part 1: Inception and Night Fighter Expansion Pack.
[*]Updated Achievements 
[/list]
[b]Singleplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Applied various Steam controller fixes.
[*]“Drop Down” added to keyboard bindings for remapping.
[*]Ensured saves don’t occur while the player is in mid-air. Also reduced occurrences of saves next to an exploding vehicle.
[*]Vehicles now resume what they were doing previously when restored from a save, and no longer persist with dead targets. Tweaked tank and pillbox vision.
[*]Fixed various weapon glitches and bugs to reduce chances of players or AI having no visible weapon, or weapons held in the wrong pose or using the wrong animation. Picked-up weapons now retain their skin if that was not the base model.
[*]Scope will no longer allow the player to see through various objects.
[*]Fixed binocular reticule glitch in 3D.
[*]Standing in a bush no longer awards a foliage kill. Also improved the detection for various other stats and shot callouts.
[*]Bullet cams in Eyefinity and other super-wide resolutions should no longer zoom in excessively.
[*]AI now slightly less prone to exploitation by player during investigations. Dead bodies more likely to stop AI running into obvious death-traps.
[*]Applied various fixes for corrupt profiles. 
[*]Fixed issues with various challenges:
[list]
[*]No Manual Reloading (Allagra Fortress)
[*]No Tagging (various)
[*]Melee Ace (Abrunza Monastery) 
[/list]
[*]Fixed miscellaneous document on Giovi Fiorini Mansion
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]The server browser can now be sorted on any column.
[*]The “Invite” button will now work when connected to dedicated servers.
[*]Dedicated servers will now be included in matchmaking.
[*]Dedicated servers now support remote connections from the Sniper Elite 4 RCON web interface. See our follow up announcement for more details.
[*]Applied various dedicated server fixes.
[*]Ensured Overwatch characters are restored right way round if starting from a save.
[*]Players will be harder to tag through objects.
[*]Applied various out-of-world and collision fixes to reduce exploits on all maps.
[/list]
We’re still aware that a small number of people are still experiencing corrupt profile issues. To help us with fixing it, if you see a ‘corrupt save’ or ‘corrupt profile’ error on startup, could you immediately Alt-Tab out of the game and backup your save data to send to Customer Support.
http://www.rebellion.co.uk/support

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Small update today!

[h1]Singleplayer:[/h1][list]
[*]Authentic mode now shows exfiltration icons on the map so players know where to go to finish the mission.
[*]Fixed bug where game progress could be lost when save profile data got too large. This should also prevent corruption of the custom controls. For those who have already lost progress we have a further patch undergoing testing to restore, as best we can tell, the progress you have lost. Please bear with us![/list]
[h1]Multiplayer:[/h1][list]
[*]Viewing the game settings menu no longer causes the clients game settings to become out of sync with the host
[*]Fix an instance where joining a different lobby to the one selected from the browser could occur.[/list]

notes.title: FIRST POST-LAUNCH PATCH & CONTENT OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. We can’t quite believe it’s only been a week since Sniper Elite 4 released! Thank you for all your support, feedback and kind comments. It’s been a special month for the team.

Today we’re releasing the game’s first post-launch patch on Steam for PC, and dropping some new content packs. Details below!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bX2vFsa.jpg[/img]

[h1]DOWNLOAD TODAY: NEW CHARACTER + WEAPONS PACKS[/h1]
Tailored for covert warfare, two new packs are available to purchase today. If you own the Sniper Elite 4 Deluxe Edition or Season Pass, both will unlock automatically!

[b]Covert Heroes Character Pack[/b]
Expand your force with three formidable new characters. Play as the elite Russian sniper Roza Petrovna of the Red Army 25th Rifle Division, the highly-trained British Commando or the ghillie-clad trooper!

[b]Silent Warfare Weapons Pack[/b]
Equip your campaign, multiplayer or co-op loadouts for total stealth with the silenced Carbine and HDM semi-automatic pistol and then mop up any survivors with the powerful new Grease Gun!

[h1]DOWNLOAD TODAY: PC PATCH 1.1.2[/h1]
Our first PC patch launches today. We’ll continue to monitor your feedback and further improve the game.

[b]New options:[/b][list]
[*]A full-screen borderless window option is now supported from the launcher. This is an alpha release and we welcome any feedback in the forums. Thank you to everyone who requested this!
[*] “Binaural Simulation” audio settings are now available on the launcher and defaults to “off” rather than being enabled as part of the “Headphones” audio option. This will fix stuttering on a limited number of processors. [/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b][list]
[*] Fixes to the multiplayer browser – the filter tick-boxes should now be fully functional and the list of games should sorted in a more sensible order.
[*]Dedicated servers should no longer report one of the players as the host.
[*]Fixes for various crashes and disconnections.
[*]Various localisation fixes.[/list]
[b]Singleplayer[/b][list]
[*]Various localisation fixes
[*]Fixes for various crashes[/list]
[i]Remember also to head over to our [url=http://sniperelite4.com/en/news/12 ]last blog[/url] post to see what’s in store for the Sniper Elite community over the next few weeks and months.[/i]
